content: पूर्व {%a.%} (Declined like a pronoun when it implies relative position in time or space, but optionally so in <ab>nom.</ab> <ab>pl.</ab>; and <ab>abl.</ab> and <ab>loc.</ab> <ab>sing.</ab>) .²1 Being in front of, first, foremost. .²2 Eastern, easterly, to the east of; ग्रामात् पर्वतः पूर्वः <ls>Sk.</ls>; पूर्वापरौ तोयनिधी वगाह्य <ls>Ku. 1. 1</ls>. .²3 Previous to, earlier than; ब्राह्मणे साहसः पूर्वः <ls>Ms. 8. 276</ls>. .²4 Old, ancient; पूर्वसूरिभिः <ls>R. 1. 4</ls>; इदं कविभ्यः पूर्वेभ्यो नमोवाकं प्रशास्महे <ls>U. 1. 1</ls>. .²5 Former, previous, anterior, prior, antecedent (<ab>opp.</ab> उत्तर); in this sense often at the end of <ab>comp.</ab> and translated by ‘formerly’ or ‘before’; श्रुतपूर्व <ab>&c.</ab>; व्यतीता या निशा पूर्वा पौराणां हर्षवर्धिनी <ls>Rām. 7. 37. 1</ls>. .²6 Aforesaid, before-mentioned. .²7 Initial. .²8 Established, customary, of long standing .²9 Early, prime, पूर्वे वयसि <ls>Pt. 1. 165</ls> ‘in early age or prime of life’. .²10 Elder (ज्येष्ठ); रामः पूर्वो हि नो भ्राता भविष्यति महीपतिः <ls>Rām. 2. 79. 8</ls>. .²11 (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) Preceded by, accompanied by, attended with; संबन्धमाभाषणपूर्वमाहुः <ls>R. 2. 58</ls>; पुण्यः शब्दो मुनिरिति मुहुः केवलं राजपूर्वः <ls>Ś. 2. 17</ls>; तान् स्मितपूर्वमाह <ls>Ku. 7. 47</ls>; बहुमानपूर्वया <ls n="Ku.">5. 31</ls>; दशपूर्वरथं यमाख्यया दशकण्ठारिगुरुं विदुर्बुधाः <ls>R. 8. 29</ls>; so मतिपूर्वम् <ls>Ms. 11. 147</ls> ‘intentionally’, ‘knowingly’; <ls n="Ms.">12. 89</ls>; अबोधपूर्वम् ‘unconsciously’, <ls>Ś. 5. 2</ls> <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-र्वः@} An ancestor, a forefather; पूर्वैः किलायं परिवर्धितो नः <ls>R. 13. 3</ls>; पयः पूर्वैः सनिश्वासैः कवोष्णमुपभुज्यते <ls n="R.">1. 67</ls>, <ls n="R.">5. 14</ls>; अनुकारिणि पूर्वेषां युक्तरूपमिदं त्वयि <ls>Ś. 2. 17</ls>. .{@-र्वम्@} The forepart; अनवरतधनुर्ज्यास्फालनक्रूरपूर्वम् (गात्रम्) <ls>Ś. 2. 4</ls>. .{@-र्वा@} .²1 The east .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a country to the east of Madhyadeśa. .{@-र्वम्@} {%ind.%} .²1 Before (with <ab>abl.</ab>); मासात् पूर्वम्. .²2 Formerly, previously, at first, antecedently, beforehand; तं पूर्वमभिवादयेत् <ls>Ms. 2. 117</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">3. 94</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">8. 205</ls>; <ls>R. 12. 35</ls>; प्रणिपातपूर्वम् <ls>K.</ls>; भूतपूर्वखरालयम् <ls>U. 2. 17</ls> ‘which formerly was the abode’, <ab>&c.</ab>; समयपूर्वम् <ls>Ś. 5</ls> ‘after a formal agreement’. .²3 Immemorially. (पूर्वेण ‘in front’, ‘before’, ‘to the east of’, with <ab>gen.</ab> or <ab>acc.</ab>); अद्य पूर्वम् ‘till-now’, ‘hitherto’; .{@पूर्वः--ततः--पश्चात्--उपरि@} ‘first--then, first--afterwards’, ‘previously, subsequently’, {@पूर्वम्--अधुना@} or {@--अद्य@} ‘formerly--now’.
